kinds.description: A named sidebar focus grouping saved views. v1 string patterns and lengths (uuid v4/v7 ids, #RRGGBB colour, 1-60 code-point names) are NOT enforced by the store in this revision; they must be enforced by a Foci consumer, and store-level text formats are pending. Cardinality one on parent is not enforced by the store; one parent, no cycles and depth <= 1 belong to a Foci consumer. No audience-change guard exists yet: a write is not fenced against a concurrent change to the home's access policy.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Human name shown in the sidebar. v1's name limits must be enforced by a Foci consumer; this package does not enforce them. The interpreter's 4,096-byte text ceiling still applies.

fields.name: colour
fields.description: Optional #RRGGBB colour. The pattern must be enforced by a Foci consumer; this package does not enforce it. The interpreter's 4,096-byte text ceiling still applies.

fields.name: view_order
fields.description: Ordered saved-view ids for this focus. May be empty. Id shapes must be enforced by a Foci consumer; this package does not enforce them. The interpreter's 4,096-byte text ceiling still applies to each id.
